tagline.en: Changchun to Shenzhen through eleven provinces, with a suspension bridge over the Yangtze at Nanjing; finished in 2020
tagline.zh: 自长春至深圳，穿行十一个省级行政区，在南京以悬索桥跨越长江；2020 年全线贯通

start.zh: 广东省深圳市龙岗区金钱坳枢纽，接沈海高速

end.zh: 吉林省长春市绿园区西湖大路交口，邻长春西站

en: G25 is one of the long north–south expressways of the national network. It passes through eleven provincial-level divisions — Jilin, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Hebei, Tianjin, Shandong, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, Fujian and Guangdong — over 3,658 km by Chinese Wikipedia's count; the Jilin transport department gave 3,585 km when it announced the road complete in 2017.

From Changchun it crosses the plain by Shuangliao, a strip of Horqin Left Rear Banner in Inner Mongolia, and Kangping, Zhangwu, Fuxin, Beipiao, Chaoyang and Lingyuan in western Liaoning; crosses the mountains to Chengde and comes down to Tangshan and Tianjin. Between Tianjin and Dongying it shares its carriageway with G18. It crosses Shandong by Binzhou, Qingzhou, Linqu, Yishui and Linyi, enters Jiangsu at Lianyungang, runs by Huai'an and touches Anhui at Tianchang before crossing the Yangtze at Nanjing. South of the river it goes by Liyang, Yixing and Huzhou to Hangzhou, then up the Fuchun River by Fuyang, Tonglu and Jiande to Jinhua and Lishui, through the hills of northern Fujian by Nanping and Sanming, and into Guangdong by Meizhou, Heyuan and Huizhou to Shenzhen.
Much of it is still known by its older provincial names. Around Hangzhou the road signed G25 is what people call the Hangxinjing (Hangzhou–Xin'anjiang–Jiande) Expressway.
zh: 长深高速是国家高速公路网中的南北纵线之一。它途经吉林、内蒙古、辽宁、河北、天津、山东、江苏、安徽、浙江、福建、广东十一个省级行政区，据中文维基百科全长 3,658 公里；吉林省交通运输厅 2017 年宣布全线贯通时给出的数字是 3,585 公里。

自长春出发，穿过平原经双辽，取道内蒙古科尔沁左翼后旗的一小段，再经辽西的康平、彰武、阜新、北票、朝阳、凌源；翻山至承德，下行至唐山、天津。天津至东营段与 G18 荣乌高速共线。其后经滨州、青州、临朐、沂水、临沂横穿山东，在连云港进入江苏，经淮安，在天长擦过安徽，于南京跨越长江。江南经溧阳、宜兴、湖州至杭州，再溯富春江经富阳、桐庐、建德至金华、丽水，穿闽北山地经南平、三明，入广东经梅州、河源、惠州抵深圳。
不少路段至今仍以各省原来的路名为人所知。杭州一带挂 G25 牌子的路，人们叫它杭新景高速。

en: The Chengde–Tangshan section, 125.9 km for 80 km/h, was the first six-lane mountain expressway in Hebei: six lanes north of Zunhua and four south of it, with bridges and tunnels making up more than 40% of the route. The 82.3 km in Chengde alone has 79 bridges and 16 tunnels.

G25 crosses the Yangtze on the Qixiashan Bridge at Nanjing, built as the Fourth Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, 4.3 km downstream of the Xinshengwei bridge. It is a three-span continuous suspension bridge with a main span of 1,418 m — when it opened in 2012, the longest of its type in China and third in the world — and towers 223 m high. The project as a whole is 28.996 km long, of which the river bridge is 5.448 km, with six lanes. The press called it 'China's Golden Gate'. Its designers introduced a new structural system with elastic vertical restraints at the towers, which the Nanjing government credits with lengthening the fatigue life of the cables, hangers and deck.
Between Lianyungang and Huai'an the original four-lane road was widened to eight lanes between 2021 and 2025.
zh: 承德至唐山段全长 125.9 公里，设计时速 80 公里，是河北省第一条山区六车道高速公路：遵化以北双向六车道，以南双向四车道，桥隧比例超过 40%。仅承德段 82.3 公里就有特大桥、大桥、中桥 79 座，隧道 16 座。

长深高速在南京经栖霞山长江大桥过江，工程名南京长江第四大桥，位于新生圩长江大桥下游约 4.3 公里。主桥为三跨连续钢箱梁悬索桥，主跨 1,418 米——2012 年通车时在同类桥型中居国内第一、世界第三——主塔高 223 米。工程全长 28.996 公里，其中跨江大桥 5.448 公里，双向六车道，被媒体称为“中国的金门大桥”。设计中首创了竖向弹性约束的新型结构体系；南京市政府称它改善了主缆、吊索和主梁的受力，延长了疲劳寿命。
连云港至淮安段于 2021 至 2025 年间由双向四车道扩建为双向八车道。

en: G25 was assembled from provincial roads opened at different times. Among the later pieces: the Tangshan part of Chengde–Tangshan opened in 2007; Lianyungang–Linyi, 55.7 km, in November 2010; the Qixiashan Bridge on 24 December 2012, after work began on 28 December 2008; the third phase of the Shenyang–Kangping expressway, 23.73 km, on 6 July 2015; and Daling–Shuangliao, 118.5 km, in 2015.

On 30 November 2017 the last 6.18 km, from Changchun to Daling, opened, and the Jilin transport department declared the whole 3,585 km Changchun–Shenzhen Expressway through. One gap in fact remained, in Zhejiang between Jiande and Jinhua. The Jiande–Jinhua Expressway opened on 22 December 2020; the Jiande government said it completed G25, and Hangzhou's news site called it the final section of the whole route; from then a driver could go from Hangzhou to Shenzhen on G25 alone.
zh: 长深高速是由各省先后建成的路段拼接而成的。较晚建成的几段：承唐高速唐山段一期 2007 年通车；连云港至临沂段 55.7 公里 2010 年 11 月通车；栖霞山长江大桥 2008 年 12 月 28 日开工、2012 年 12 月 24 日通车；沈康高速三期 23.73 公里 2015 年 7 月 6 日通车；大岭至双辽段 118.5 公里 2015 年通车。
2017 年 11 月 30 日，最后的长春至大岭段 6.18 公里通车，吉林省交通运输厅宣布全长 3,585 公里的长深高速全线贯通。实际上浙江建德至金华之间仍有缺口。2020 年 12 月 22 日建金高速通车，建德方面称这标志着长深高速全线贯通，杭州网称之为长深高速全线的收官路段；从此由杭州出发，可沿长深高速一路直达深圳。

en: There is no published total. Published section figures include ¥6.508 billion as the approved estimate for the 124.7 km Changchun–Shuangliao expressway, of which the final 6.18 km into Changchun was put at ¥1.114 billion; ¥6.857 billion as the approved estimate for the Qixiashan Bridge project, which the Nanjing government later gave as about ¥7.1 billion; and ¥9.376 billion for the 58.09 km Jiande–Jinhua section, whose investment and construction was led by Zhejiang Communications Investment Group.
zh: 全线总造价未见公布。已公布的分段数字包括：124.7 公里的长春至双辽高速概算总投资 65.08 亿元，其中进入长春的最后 6.18 公里概算 11.14 亿元；栖霞山长江大桥工程概算总投资 68.57 亿元，南京市政府后来给出的投资约为 71 亿元；58.09 公里的建金高速总投资 93.76 亿元，由浙江省交通集团牵头投资建设。

en: The Jiande–Jinhua section took about an hour off the drive between the two cities. When the Qixiashan Bridge opened in 2012 a car paid ¥25 to cross it.
zh: 建金高速使建德至金华的车程缩短约一小时。栖霞山长江大桥 2012 年通车时，小型客车通行费为 25 元。

timeline.en: The Tangshan part of the Chengde–Tangshan expressway opens.
timeline.zh: 承唐高速唐山段一期通车。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Fourth Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 28 日，南京长江第四大桥开工。
11 月，连云港至临沂段 55.7 公里通车。

timeline.en: The Qixiashan Bridge opens across the Yangtze at Nanjing on 24 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 24 日，栖霞山长江大桥（南京四桥）通车。

timeline.en: Shenyang–Kangping phase 3 opens on 6 July; Daling–Shuangliao, 118.5 km, also opens.
timeline.zh: 7 月 6 日，沈康高速三期通车；大岭至双辽段 118.5 公里亦于当年通车。

timeline.en: Changchun–Daling opens on 30 November and Jilin declares G25 complete.
timeline.zh: 11 月 30 日，长春至大岭段通车，吉林省宣布长深高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Jiande–Jinhua Expressway opens on 22 December, closing the last gap.
timeline.zh: 12 月 22 日，建金高速通车，补上最后一段缺口。

timeline.en: Widening of Lianyungang–Huai'an to eight lanes is substantially finished in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，连云港至淮安段八车道扩建基本完工通车。
